page_title: Client-APP previews the video through hotspot connection
page_content:
#### Prerequisites:
- If the device has a WiFi module, switch to AP mode to connect. If the device does not have a WiFi module, insert E-set into the USB port to connect to the hotspot
- Download and install the APP. For the download address, see the document above---Platform Software Download Article
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=495fc9af2faf4ee566b99ffcb219ac0b)

#### Operation steps:
#####The device has a WiFi module
1. Remotely enter Menu>>Settings>>Network Settings>>WiFi, enter the WiFi configuration interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=931c314da1b9161e60810da3e9751d61)![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=9bd70f30d7191ffad9363bd937ae32c3)

2. Move to the WiFi mode bar Select AP mode, confirm and save
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c2125bf7205e4929f53fdbb15d923c26)


#####Insert the E-set module into the device
1. Insert the E-set into the USB port of the device, the device will automatically recognize and switch to AP mode
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile& sign=eca0749b47221101c1d7a3eb904e9fde)

2. Press the arrow key on the remote control to go to the network status to view the AP mode status
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=103265f6a01e29f8d8368a2192d6d50a)

#####Connection and use
1. Open the mobile phone wifi to connect to the wifi named "MDVR+device number", click to connect, the default password is 99999999
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b7f56a01dd80dd7e4577d3abc8aca785)

2. After the phone connects to the device's wifi hotspot, click the 'Search' button
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=13a76b562c79bba03a16d1f2df5079de)

3. After entering, click the device connected to wifi No.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0c106c32949f3d54e6a909536b25f364)

4. Preview channel screen in default interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=846d5ba2c4550e54f7e32a57bd05fe9e)

5. The bottom navigation bar has Playback menu, more (WEB menu) configuration use
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b32fc84f8e77446b3cf6accc163d27ee)![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=2e1097fa787603d2ec7fb9414c9674a1)
